heroes.body: The 94-paragraph text recalls Dubai's stocktake whole but never names fossil fuels; the 35% power goal stays weak and the $120bn adaptation target is gone. (Carbon Brief)
heroes.dek: Final text goes to the 06:00 GMT approval session two days late
heroes.headline: THE TEXT THAT NAMES NO FUEL
heroes.verify: Carbon Brief rundown of the presidency's third (final) draft cover decision, published 03:00 local Sun 22 Nov: 94 paragraphs, no direct fossil-fuel reference, recalls the COP28 UAE consensus in its entirety, weak wording toward the 35-by-35 electrification target, no $120bn adaptation target (tripling reaffirmed without baseline), first acknowledgment of 1.5C overshoot. Reuters: package put to an approval session opening 06:00 GMT after the 03:00 GMT objections deadline passed; as of build time (~08:05 GMT) no wire had confirmed the gavel on the cover decision, so the hero states the final text and the session, not adoption.
